# IU Study Time Manager

> A comprehensive study time management application for students.

Visit the application at: [https://stm.shadehost.eu](https://stm.shadehost.eu)

## About

IU Study Time Manager helps students track their study sessions, set goals, manage calendar events, and monitor their academic progress. Available in both German and English at [https://stm.shadehost.eu/de](https://stm.shadehost.eu/de) and [https://stm.shadehost.eu/en](https://stm.shadehost.eu/en).

## Features

- Study time tracking and timer
- Goal setting and progress monitoring
- Calendar integration with ICS import
- Achievement system
- Statistics and analytics
- Multi-language support (German/English)
- Dark/Light theme
- Progressive Web App (PWA) capabilities

For more details, see the [English documentation](https://stm.shadehost.eu/en/legal/privacy) and [German documentation](https://stm.shadehost.eu/de/legal/privacy).

## Stack

- Built with [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/), [React](https://react.dev/), and [TanStack Router](https://tanstack.com/router)
- Backend powered by [Bun](https://bun.sh) and [Nitro](https://nitro.unjs.io/)
- Database with [Drizzle ORM](https://orm.drizzle.team/)
- Styled with [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/)
